title: Caller/callee precondition
contract: Caller accepts integers -2..2. Callee is defined only for x>=0 and returns x*x. Caller must establish callee precondition and return input square.
scope: Finite integers -2..2, one call and no side effects.
assumptions: Exact finite abstract model in scope; no inference to unbounded behavior, LLMLang correspondence or other semantic profiles.

obligations.claim: Call argument nonnegative and returned result equals original input squared.

variants.description: Use conditional negation rather than absolute value.
